title: SpaceX - Static Fire Anomaly - AMOS-6 - 09-01-2016
summary: USLaunchReport footage of the September 2016 SpaceX Falcon 9 static fire anomaly that destroyed the rocket and AMOS-6 satellite at Launch Complex 40.
why: HN people link it as the reference footage of the earlier SpaceX pad explosion when discussing later launch failures.

quote.text: is a video of SpaceX's failure.
